# JSFeat

Vendored from https://github.com/inspirit/jsfeat at commit
`4c7b336bbeeb26e6cd4cdf3c7d414abe273846f3`, `build/jsfeat.js`.

Original author: Eugene Zatepyakin. MIT license is retained in
`LICENSE-jsfeat.txt`. The source is unmodified.

The host mini program uses this library without DOM APIs for grayscale,
feature descriptors and homography kernels. Device compatibility and image
tracking quality must still be validated on the actual HarmonyOS WeChat client.
